design: The owner's pooled flow: each community is discovered (Sylph, Strobealign) and coassembled (MEGAHIT) on its own; iterate then shares both coassemblies' contigs, maps every discovery pool to them, and pools all unassigned pairs into one assembly per round (--all-samples), for at most 3 rounds. Arms: round1 = the coassemblies after acceptance (>= 1,000 bp, containment removed); residual-only and recruitment = pooled final contigs; *-by-community = later rounds kept per community; all-reads = grouped all-read assembly (all-reads-pooled: all samples in one). Inputs count every round's assemblies. Held-out genomes are species absent from the catalogue; genomes with a catalogued relative of the same species count as explained.

data.purpose: a novel genome too thin per group but assemblable when all samples are pooled
